name: moai-library-shadcn
title: 扩展：触发器
description: Provides shadcn/ui component library expertise for React applications with Tailwind CSS. Use when implementing UI components, design systems, or component composition with shadcn/ui, Radix primitives, or Tailwind-based component libraries. Do NOT use for non-React frameworks or custom CSS-only styling (use moai-domain-frontend instead).
